item.text:
Mistral AI officially lists these commonly supported SAML identity providers:

- Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory)
- Google Workspace / Google Identity Platform
- Okta

Yes. Mistral says that any SAML-compliant identity provider can work, so you can use a different provider. You should follow that provider’s SAML application configuration instructions. Organization SSO requires SAML 2.0; OIDC is not supported. [Mistral SAML SSO documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/saml-sso)
